id: 24_10 Important Electrical Safety Rules Every Worker Must Follow
title: 用电安全十条守则
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/24_10 Important Electrical Safety Rules Every Worker Must Follow.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/24_10 Important Electrical Safety Rules Every Worker Must Follow/src.py

points.K5: 守则四：用前检查工具和电线
points.K7: 守则六：额定值要对，不超载
points.K10: 守则九：电气作业，授权才能干
points.K11: 守则十：发现隐患马上报告

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白卷轴，上面有十个小圆点
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank scroll with ten small numbered dots and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲用电安全十条守则。

shots.scene: 实验室插线板冒出火花，阿杰吓了一跳
shots.prompt_en: A small spark flashes from a power strip on a lab bench; the young male student jumps back in surprise.
shots.narration: 插线板突然冒了个火花。

shots.scene: 阿杰拍拍插线板，想接着用
shots.prompt_en: The young male student taps the power strip and reaches to plug his device back in.
shots.narration: 阿杰拍了拍，还想接着用。

shots.scene: 老周按住插线板，拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The older man puts his hand over the power strip to stop him and picks up the phone.
shots.narration: 老周说：停，先断电，再报告。

shots.scene: 灯、电脑、仪器图标被电线连在一起
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lamp, a computer and a lab instrument connected by power cords. No people.
shots.narration: 电，我们天天都离不开。

shots.scene: 触电、烧伤、火灾三个警示图标
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons: a lightning bolt hitting a hand, a burn mark and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 不守规则，就会触电、烧伤、起火，

shots.scene: 一个红色停止标志
shots.prompt_en: A large red stop sign beside a broken cable icon. No people.
shots.narration: 甚至造成死亡事故。

shots.scene: 老李拉下开关，挂锁和空白挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the main disconnect and attaches a padlock and a blank red tag.
shots.narration: 检查、维修、保养前，先彻底断电。

shots.scene: 有人想合闸，被挂锁挡住
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching for the locked switch, blocked by the padlock, red X. No people.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌，防止中途被人送电。

shots.scene: 带电设备上作业的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person working inside a live cabinet with sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 在带电设备上干活，非常危险。

shots.scene: 老李穿戴绝缘手套、绝缘鞋、防电弧服、安全帽、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears insulating gloves, insulating boots, an arc-resistant suit, a hard hat and safety goggles.
shots.narration: 电气作业，防护用品一样不能少。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标挡住火花
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon blocking sparks and a small arc flash. No people.
shots.narration: 它能挡住严重的伤害。

shots.scene: 配电柜里的端子旁有闪电和问号
shots.prompt_en: Terminals inside an open cabinet with a lightning bolt and a question mark above them. No people.
shots.narration: 别以为线路是安全的。

shots.scene: 老李用验电笔测试，确认后打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests the terminals with a voltage tester pen; a green check appears only after the test.
shots.narration: 测试确认之前，一律当作带电。

shots.scene: 小小的手指图标旁，一个巨大的警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A tiny finger icon next to a huge warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 一个小失误，就是大事故。

shots.section_title: 守则四：用前检查工具和电线
shots.scene: 小研拿起电钻，检查电线和插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a power drill and checks its cord and plug.
shots.narration: 用之前，先查工具和电线。
overlay: 守则四：用前检查工具和电线

shots.section_title: 守则四：用前检查工具和电线
shots.scene: 绝缘破损、导线裸露、插头松动、电缆断裂四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: cracked insulation, an exposed wire, a loose plug and a broken cable. No people.
shots.narration: 破皮、露线、插头松、线断了，

shots.section_title: 守则四：用前检查工具和电线
shots.scene: 坏电钻挂上空白停用牌，小研打电话
shots.prompt_en: The damaged drill gets a blank do-not-use tag; the female graduate student makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 就别用了，马上报告、更换。

shots.scene: 水滴和闪电靠在一起，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A water droplet icon touching a lightning bolt with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 水和电碰在一起，非常危险。

shots.scene: 阿杰擦干手后才去按开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student dries his hands with a paper towel before pressing an instrument switch.
shots.narration: 擦干手，再碰开关和仪器。

shots.scene: 积水地面上用电动工具的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power tool used on a flooded floor, crossed out with a red X, next to a wet floor caution sign. No people.
shots.narration: 地上有水，不用电动工具。

shots.section_title: 守则六：额定值要对，不超载
shots.scene: 仪器铭牌和插座额定值图标对比，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank instrument nameplate icon next to a socket icon, matching ratings with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 设备、熔断器、断路器，额定值要对。
overlay: 守则六：额定值要对，不超载

shots.section_title: 守则六：额定值要对，不超载
shots.scene: 插线板插满大功率插头，发红冒烟
shots.prompt_en: An overloaded power strip with many high-power plugs glowing red and smoking. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板别超载。

shots.section_title: 守则六：额定值要对，不超载
shots.scene: 电线过热起火的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an overheating cable bursting into a small flame. No people.
shots.narration: 规格不对、超负荷，就会过热起火。

shots.scene: 校园配电室和变压器，门上有止步高压危险标志
shots.prompt_en: A campus substation building and a fenced transformer with a high voltage danger sign on the gate. No people.
shots.narration: 变压器、配电室、架空线、高压柜，

shots.scene: 阿杰在围栏前停步，转身离开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops at the barrier tape in front of the transformer fence and turns away.
shots.narration: 没有授权，不要靠近、不要进入。

shots.scene: 警示标志和隔离围栏，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Warning signs and a barricade around the area with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 看到警示标志和围栏，一定要遵守。

shots.scene: 仪器外壳接着黄绿接地线
shots.prompt_en: The metal case of a lab instrument connected by a green and yellow wire to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 接地，是故障时的保护。

shots.scene: 接地线断开，电流箭头转向人形图标
shots.prompt_en: The ground wire is broken and a current arrow turns toward a person pictogram touching the case, red X. No people.
shots.narration: 接地不好，电流就可能走人体。

shots.scene: 老李检查接地端子，旁边日历
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a grounding terminal, a calendar icon beside him.
shots.narration: 接地系统，要定期检查。

shots.section_title: 守则九：电气作业，授权才能干
shots.scene: 老李手持空白操作证站在配电柜前
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a blank work permit card in front of a distribution cabinet.
shots.narration: 电气作业，只能由培训授权的人做。
overlay: 守则九：电气作业，授权才能干

shots.section_title: 守则九：电气作业，授权才能干
shots.scene: 学生打开配电柜、拆修电器两个图标，都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons each crossed out with a red X: a student opening a distribution cabinet, and a student repairing an appliance. No people.
shots.narration: 没培训过，不维修、不开配电柜。

shots.section_title: 守则九：电气作业，授权才能干
shots.scene: 欣欣摇头摆手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head and waves a paw.
shots.narration: 跟电开玩笑，后果很严重。

shots.section_title: 守则十：发现隐患马上报告
shots.scene: 火花、焦味、裸线、过热、频繁跳闸五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a spark, a smoke wisp for burning smell, an exposed wire, a hot instrument and a breaker flipping repeatedly. No people.
shots.narration: 看到这些，马上报告。
overlay: 守则十：发现隐患马上报告

shots.section_title: 守则十：发现隐患马上报告
shots.scene: 阿杰打电话，王老师在空白记录本上记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes a phone call while the safety administrator writes in a blank log book.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人，及时处理。

shots.section_title: 守则十：发现隐患马上报告
shots.scene: 小隐患渐渐长成大火苗的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tiny spark gradually growing into a large flame over a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 今天不管，明天就是大事故。

shots.scene: 师生们手拉手围成一圈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, the young male student, the older man and the facility engineer stand together in a circle.
shots.narration: 安全不是一个人的事，是大家的事。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着当心触电标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an electric shock warning sign.
shots.narration: 认得电气安全标志，才知道怎么做。

shots.scene: 当心触电、止步高压危险、禁止合闸三个标志
shots.prompt_en: Three signs side by side: an electric shock warning sign, a high voltage danger stop sign, and a do-not-switch-on prohibition tag. No people.
shots.narration: 当心触电、止步高压危险、禁止合闸。

shots.scene: 阿杰看到标志，后退一步
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees the warning sign on a cabinet door and steps back.
shots.narration: 看到标志，照着做，不越过。

shots.scene: 拽着电线拔插头的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand yanking a plug out by its cord, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 拔插头，别拽电线。

shots.scene: 小研先关仪器开关，再捏住插头拔下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the instrument first, then grips the plug body and pulls it out.
shots.narration: 先关开关，再捏住插头拔。

shots.scene: 插头插进一半、半悬着的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plug half-inserted and loose in a socket with a small spark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插头要插到底，松动的不能用。

shots.scene: 烘箱散热口被纸箱和布挡住，冒热气
shots.prompt_en: A drying oven with its vent blocked by cardboard boxes and a cloth, heat waves rising. No people.
shots.narration: 电器的散热口，不能被挡住。

shots.scene: 小研把纸箱搬开，留出空隙
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves the boxes away, leaving clear space around the oven vent.
shots.narration: 四周留出空间，别堆杂物。

shots.scene: 仪器上盖着布的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a running instrument covered with a cloth, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 运行中的设备，不要盖布防尘。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现挂锁、手套、验电笔图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a padlock, an insulating glove and a voltage tester pen.
shots.narration: 先断电挂牌，穿戴防护，验电确认。

shots.scene: 放大镜、水滴打叉、插线板图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a magnifying glass, a crossed-out water droplet and a power strip with one plug. No people.
shots.narration: 用前检查，远离水，不超载。

shots.scene: 高压标志、接地符号、操作证图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a high voltage sign, a ground symbol and a blank work permit card. No people.
shots.narration: 远离高压，接地可靠，授权作业。

shots.scene: 电话、标志、插头、散热口图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a telephone, a warning sign, a plug held correctly and a clear vent. No people.
shots.narration: 隐患要报告，认标志，插拔散热都留心。

shots.scene: 欣欣卷起卷轴，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot rolls up the blank scroll and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 十条守则记心上，下次见！
